description: This file defines a React functional component 'NoteView' that displays a note's content fetched from an API and allows summarization. It handles loading states, error handling, and displays note details along with a summary if available.

methods.name: fetchNote
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches note data based on the URL parameter 'id' and updates component state.

methods.name: onSummarize
methods.description: Triggers the note summarization process and updates the summary displayed.
